title: Choosing an Evening English Course
instructions: 这是一份为A2学习者设计的英语听力与语法练习，主题是“学习目标与学习习惯”。场景为模拟教育材料：一位成年学习者在咨询晚间英语课程。请先听/读对话，再完成8道听力理解题（单选题和填空题），然后学习一般现在时与现在进行时、频率副词、do/does问句的规则，并完成8道语法题。最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案均可在原文中找到依据。本材料不是官方雅思考试，也不代表任何分数等级。
transcript:
Mia: Good evening. I want to join an English class. Do you have evening courses?
Daniel: Yes, we do. We have a class on Tuesdays and Thursdays. It starts at seven.
Mia: How many students are in the class?
Daniel: There are twelve students. The teacher is Ms. Chen.
Mia: What do you do in the class?
Daniel: We listen to short talks. We also speak in pairs. Ms. Chen gives homework every week.
Mia: I work late on Tuesdays. Does the class finish at nine?
Daniel: No, it doesn't. It finishes at eight thirty. But you can watch the lesson online.
Mia: Good. Do I need a book?
Daniel: Yes, you do. The book costs twenty dollars.
Mia: How often do you have tests?
Daniel: We have a test every month. Ms. Chen is marking the last test now.
Mia: I am not working next Thursday. Can I visit the class?
Daniel: Sure. Please come at six fifty. The class is starting at seven.
Mia: Great. I usually study at home in the evening. But I want to speak more.
Daniel: That is a good goal. Many students practise speaking every day.
Mia: Thank you. I am writing the class time in my notebook now.

grammar.title: 一般现在时与现在进行时；频率副词；do/does问句
grammar.explanation: 一般现在时表示经常性、习惯性的动作或事实。例如：I study every day. 第三人称单数主语（he/she/it）后，动词加-s，如：She works late. 现在进行时表示现在正在进行的动作，结构是 am/is/are + 动词-ing。例如：I am writing now. 频率副词（always, usually, often, sometimes, never）放在实义动词前、be动词后。例如：I usually study at home. do/does问句用于一般现在时：Do you have a book? Does the class finish at nine? 注意：does后面动词用原形。
grammar.example: I usually study at home in the evening.
